manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Changeling Titan must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Titan for its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
